fields.title: Tech in Asia record
fields.description: The portfolio dataset envelope (_input / _source / _scrapedAt / recordType) wrapped around whatever the upstream API returned, passed through field-for-field. recordType is POST, COMPANY, JOB, CATEGORY, TAG, TOPIC, TRENDING_QUESTION or ERROR. Upstream adds and drops fields without notice, so anything not listed here still reaches the dataset rather than failing the run.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The slug, query, URL or mode label this record came from.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which backend answered: S1-wp-* for the WordPress newsroom, S2-algolia-* for search and funding facets, S3-laravel-* for the company database and job board, or none on error rows.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was emitted.

recordType.title: Record type
recordType.description: POST, COMPANY, JOB, CATEGORY, TAG, TOPIC, TRENDING_QUESTION or ERROR.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Error rows only: not_found, no_results, no_posts, invalid_slug, fetch_failed or mode_failed.

id.title: Id
id.description: Upstream identifier. Numeric string for articles, UUID for companies and jobs.

slug.title: Slug
slug.description: URL slug. Feed this back into postDetail to re-resolve the record.

type.title: Article type
type.description: post for full articles, short for news briefs, visual-story for the illustrated format.

author.title: Author
author.description: Byline object: display name, profile URL, avatar and staff flag.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Category objects with id, name and slug.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Tag objects with id, name and slug.

companies.title: Companies mentioned
companies.description: Companies the newsroom linked to this article.

featured_image.title: Featured image
featured_image.description: Source URL plus width, height and the CDN's derived sizes.

is_sponsored.title: Sponsored
is_sponsored.description: True when the article is paid placement. The sponsor object carries the advertiser.

is_subscriber_exclusive.title: Subscriber exclusive
is_subscriber_exclusive.description: True when the article sits behind the subscription. Note that is_paywalled is true on essentially every record and does not discriminate - this field does.

content.title: Article body
content.description: Full article HTML. Present only when includeArticleContent was turned on.

entity_slug.title: Company slug
entity_slug.description: The slug companyDetail expects. Company records from the database carry it here.

total_amount_raised.title: Total raised
total_amount_raised.description: Lifetime funding raised, in USD. Search-index records only.

last_funding_stage.title: Latest stage
last_funding_stage.description: Most recent funding stage, e.g. Seed or Series A.

is_investor.title: Is investor
is_investor.description: True when the entity invests rather than only raises.

number_investments.title: Investments made
number_investments.description: Count of investments this entity has made.

job_posting_count.title: Open roles
job_posting_count.description: How many live postings this company has on the board.

salary_min.title: Salary minimum
salary_min.description: Lower bound, in the currency object's units. Only meaningful when is_salary_visible is true.

salary_max.title: Salary maximum
salary_max.description: Upper bound, in the currency object's units.

period.title: Salary period
period.description: MONTHLY or YEARLY - the two bounds mean nothing without it.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Currency object for the salary figures.

company.title: Hiring company
company.description: Full company object embedded in each job posting.

city.title: City
city.description: City object with country and state.

pageviews.title: Pageviews
pageviews.description: Trending question rows only: pageviews over the lookback window.

position.title: Position
position.description: Trending question rows only: current leaderboard rank, with previous_position alongside.
